resources.string: Your phone helps DWT on your watch prepare weather images. Automatically, whenever your watch requests them.
Pair your watch with your phone
Use the companion app for your Wear OS watch.
When this phone is reachable, your watch can ask it to prepare weather images.
This screen does not show live status. Check the About screen on your watch to see whether weather images are loaded through your phone.
Rain, clouds and lightning – your watch also works independently without your phone. No additional account is needed.
Weather data: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD).\nIndependent project, not published by DWD.
